Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2019

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi sembilan puluh lima juta

sembilan ratus lima puluh sembilan ribu satu ratus ringgit (RM 95,959,100) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Sistem

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of the

Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2019.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2019

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding ninety-five million nine hundred and fifty-nine

thousand one hundred ringgit (RM 95,959,100) from the Employment Insurance Fund

for the expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance System for the

year 2019 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

 SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

 (RM)

Supplies and services 14,042,600
